args.body: Hi Rowan, thanks for your call today. We've noted that you're using your own contractor, Riverside Services (Freya), for the weeds and hedge at Flat 26, 46 Copperfield Walk, and that you'll pay them directly. We won't send our own contractor. Two quick things please, by Friday 7 November: 1) Can you confirm the quote figure? You said about £20,000, which sounds high for this work, so we want to be sure it's right. A copy of Freya's quote would help. 2) Please send us Freya's confirmed start date once she has it. Also, as part of the area is shared or a strip of unowned land, please check you're entitled to have it cleared. Once the work is done, let us know and we'll close the job. Thanks.
